content: Duque cala tan tsachilaca itsanque payinunca
Junni ocola, duque calaca duno munatiminlaca payichinayoe. Nulari padeseinola jochunae. Wareto, atintsan jochunae.
Nulachi titiya duque seca jonun jera yucapiyaca jochunae. Sen tsanpa jomincanan julu jera fica jochunae.

To yucapiyarino ma quelo inasanan, nulari calaca cacanilaquinae. Nulachi calari, orori, titiya jera wareto yucapiyachunae. Jun cala wareca junbe nulaca tuca miintsan jochunae seiton jominlanueque. Jun cala tenchi duque niyalaichunae.
Junni nulachi witaca trabaja quimin peyunlari Diosibe duque rocailainae padeseinayoe tito. Nulari cajosalenan pacara quito, tarinlaquinae. Junni sonban Miya Diosiri yala rocainaminlaca meránae.
In toteri piyanle senca tan chularae. Pansi chuto ticatiya munajanari caniquiminla joe. Nulari ticatiya canilaquinatonan, mulu inamin wala cuwentari jolajoe. Junni totaino ma queloinae.
Nulari epele mántanan, culpa itonlaca culpa quito puyariminla joe. Yala mantimini beconan sonba tituto, meraniquiminla joe.
Peleituto mérantsan jonunca

Junni acola, soquila, Miya Jesucristo manpatano ma fecári seque tenca cato meralarana! Jana wita quiminlari ticatiya waqueto tsanque méraminla joe. Casale suwa quimanhe. Junni wanbile manaman suwa quimanhe. Tsanque ticatiya waca junca sele mancalaquimanhe.
Miya Jesucristo manpatano ma quelo inasa, nulanan jun tsanquenan sen tenca ito meralarana!
Acola, soquila, nula tala beco beco pataalaquituna! yape nulaca culpa quitusa. Tencabe nenalarana! culpa tanunca miiminni manpatano queloinaeque.
Acola, soquila, matute Miya Diosichi mantate paminlaca tenca calaquede! Yalari padeseinatonan, seque tenca cato méramin jominlanue. Junni yala cuwentanan jochique tenfelaina!

Meralaquede! Peleitumin jominlacari pansi jolajoe timinlayoe. Matu tote Job tinun tsachi jominca tenca calaquede. Yari duque padeseinatonan, natiya peleitumin jominue. Junni Diosi tsaracari laquiramin joto, Job michi padeseinaminca jera manse patarinue.

Lachi acola, soquila, fe merántsan fiquica nulabe pachinayoe: Nulari tsarasica pachinayoe tito, Diosi mirasa juraquito pánayoe timinla joe yape uyanla nene joe tilatitusa. Aman tsanque palaquituna! tiyoe. Itsanqueri panola joe: Titiya tsa jonari, junca janhan tintsan jochunae. Tsarasica pamin tsachila juraquitusanan, janhan o te tinari, quereinilaichunae. Junni tsanque sequeri panola joe yape nulaca culpa quilaquitusa.
Nulari manca manca padeseinatori, Diosibe rocaintsan jochunae. O pansi jotori, Diosica se tito canta quintsan jochunae.

Nula manca quiyanpun jotori, Jesucrístochi tsachila tala mantá tanlaca jasa carintsan jochunae yape quiyanpunchi tenchi Diosibe rocailaisa. Casale Jesucrístochi mantate quiyanpunca aseite nasi iliponola jochunae.

Junsi aman Diosibe rocainola jochunae. Junni rocainato, manse suwachunaeque quereintsan jochunae. Tsanque quereito rocailainari, quiyanpun manseichunae. Diosi yaca manse suwachunae. Junni jutsa quinun tenchi quiyanpun jomin jonari, ya jutsacanan manperdonaichunae.

Junni nulachi jutsaca nula tala cuenta polaricaacaito, nulachi tenchi Diosibe rocaicaalaquina! yape nulaca manse suwasa. Seque nenamin tsachila Diosibe seque tenca cato rocailainari, Diosiri yalaca meráto tenfe jonuncatiya tsanquiniquichunae.
Matu tote Elíari chiquila cuwenta tsachinan jominue. Juntonan yari Diosibe seque tenca cato rocainue yape suwa quitusa. Junni peman wata man quitsa fecári suwa quitunue.
Junni suwa manquisa rocainunbi, suwa manquinue. Junnan ticatiya manwaqueno podeilainue.
Lachi acola, soquila, nula manca manca Diosi tsarasi pacaca telaquepochi latinari, weyanlari yalaca seque mannenasa carintsan jochunae.
Junni meralaquede! Seque mannenasa cariminlari duque jutsaca piyarisa cariminla jochunae. Tsachilaca se losa cariminla jochunae yape yucanchica jilaitusa.
